rationale.conceptual: The task utilizes established DFT+DFPT methods for electron-phonon coupling, computation of the isotropic Eliashberg function, and solving the linearized gap equation. While not novel, it requires non-trivial understanding of convergence parameters, handling of metallic systems, and correct implementation of post-processing formulas.
rationale.execution: The workflow involves setting up geometry optimization, phonon, and electron-phonon coupling runs for five compounds, each requiring multiple sequential steps (SCF, DFPT, linewidth extraction) and data post-processing. This constitutes a multi-stage pipeline with moderate orchestration and DPFT output parsing.
